node.label: Elevated circulating tetracosanoic acid concentration
node.definition: The concentration of tetracosanoic acid (a C24 straight-chain saturated fatty acid) in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

evidence.snippet: Peroxisome biogenesis disorder 7A (zellweger): Elevated circulating tetracosanoic acid concentration (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
